episode_title: Elena Verna on B2B Product-Led Growth, Viral Loops & Monetization Strategy

chunks.content: Product-Led Growth (PLG) is not just a self-serve checkout funnel. True PLG means the product itself drives user acquisition, retention, and expansion. In B2B, product loops must solve individual end-user pain points first before triggering enterprise sales motions.

Growth loops outperform marketing funnels every time. A growth loop is closed-loop input-output: User Action A creates Output B, which naturally invites New User C into the product (e.g. sharing a Miro board or Figma file). Funnels decay over time; self-reinforcing growth loops compound exponentially.

When structuring B2B pricing, Freemium builds top-of-funnel velocity, while Reverse Trials give users a taste of premium features. Don't hide core value behind a paywall too early; let users form habit loops around free utility before triggering monetization limits.
